saw_lines: Supplement buyers rarely trust a brand at first sight. They check reviews, then buy once an offer makes starting feel safe.
So the sale is won in the first two lines, where reviews and an offer must show before the buyer leaves.
Your site shows 100,000 customers and 3232 reviews, but only 1 of 30 ads carries a proof number. Put 3232 reviews on your best ads, opening two with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: The site shows 100,000 customers and 3232 reviews, but only 1 of 30 ads carries a proof number. Cold buyers need proof before they trust a new supplement. Put 3232 reviews on your best ads, opening two with a review quote.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 24 ads mention it, so new buyers have no reason to act. Open three new ads with the first order discount in line one and on the creative.
The offer appears after 93% of the copy on a median ad of 80 words. Viewers who stop never reach it, so the sale is lost before they know. Put the discount in the first two lines of every ad.

4 of 24 ads use claim words like clinically, cure or guaranteed results. Claims like these make cold buyers doubt the formula before they click. Replace them in those four ads with a review line about what customers noticed.
